text_en: So all Israel was enrolled by genealogies; and these are written in the Book of the Kings of Israel. And Judah was taken into exile in Babylon because of their unfaithfulness.
text_cn: 全以色列都统计了，且记载在《以色列列王实录》上。 犹大人因犯罪作恶被掳往巴比伦去。

text_en: Now the first to live again in their possessions in their towns were Israelites, priests, Levites, and temple servants.
text_cn: 最初回来住在自己城内复业的，是以色列人、司祭、肋未人和献身者。

text_en: And some of the people of Judah, Benjamin, Ephraim, and Manasseh lived in Jerusalem:
text_cn: 迁回耶路撒冷的，有犹大、本雅明、厄弗辣因和默纳协的子孙。

text_en: Uthai son of Ammihud, son of Omri, son of Imri, son of Bani, from the sons of Perez son of Judah.
text_cn: 犹大的子孙中有：阿米胡得的儿子乌泰；阿米胡得是敖默黎的儿子，敖默黎是依默黎的儿子，依默黎是巴尼的儿子，巴尼是犹大的儿子培勒兹的儿子。

text_en: And of the Shilonites: Asaiah the firstborn, and his sons.
text_cn: 舍拉人中，有长子阿撒雅和他的儿子们；

text_en: Of the sons of Zerah: Jeuel and their kin, six hundred ninety.
text_cn: 则辣黑的子孙中，有耶乌耳。他们同族兄弟共计六百九十人。

text_en: Of the Benjaminites: Sallu son of Meshullam, son of Hodaviah, son of Hassenuah,
text_cn: 本雅明的子孙中，有默叔蓝的儿子撒路；默叔蓝是曷狄雅的儿子，曷狄雅是哈斯奴阿的儿子。

text_en: Ibneiah son of Jeroham, Elah son of Uzzi, son of Michri, and Meshullam son of Shephatiah, son of Reuel, son of Ibnijah;
text_cn: 此外尚有耶路罕的儿子依贝乃雅，乌齐的儿子厄拉；乌齐是米革黎的儿子；又有舍法提雅的儿子默叔蓝，舍法提雅是勒乌耳的儿子，勒乌耳是依贝尼雅的儿子。

text_en: and their kindred according to their generations, nine hundred fifty-six. All these were heads of families according to their ancestral houses.
text_cn: 按家系他们同族兄弟，共计九百五十六人：这些人都是各家族的族长。

text_en: Of the priests: Jedaiah, Jehoiarib, Jachin,
text_cn: 司祭中，有耶达雅、约雅黎布、雅津，

text_en: and Azariah son of Hilkiah, son of Meshullam, son of Zadok, son of Meraioth, son of Ahitub, the chief officer of the house of God;
text_cn: 和希耳克雅的儿子阿匝黎雅；希耳克雅是默叔蓝的儿子，默叔蓝是匝多克的儿子、匝多克是默辣约特的儿子，默辣约特是阿希突布的儿子，阿希突布是天主圣殿之长。

text_en: and Adaiah son of Jeroham, son of Pashhur, son of Malchijah, and Maasai son of Adiel, son of Jahzerah, son of Meshullam, son of Meshillemith, son of Immer;
text_cn: 此外，有耶洛罕的儿子阿达雅；耶洛罕是帕市胡尔的儿子，帕市胡尔是玛耳基雅的儿子；还有阿狄耳的儿子玛赛；阿狄耳是雅赫则辣的儿子，雅赫则辣是默叔蓝的儿子，默叔蓝是默史肋米特的儿子，默史肋米特是依默尔的儿子；

text_en: besides their kindred, heads of their ancestral houses, one thousand seven hundred sixty, qualified for the work of the service of the house of God.
text_cn: 连他们同族的兄弟，家族的族长，共计一千七百六十人，为天主圣殿服务，都是有本领的人。

text_en: Of the Levites: Shemaiah son of Hasshub, son of Azrikam, son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;
text_cn: 肋未人中，有哈叔布的儿子舍玛雅；哈叔布是阿次黎冈的儿子，阿次黎冈是哈沙彼雅的儿子：以上是默辣黎的子孙。

text_en: and Bakbakkar, Heresh, Galal, and Mattaniah son of Mica, son of Zichri, son of Asaph;
text_cn: 还有巴刻巴卡、赫勒士、加拉耳和米加的儿子玛塔尼雅；米加是齐革黎的儿子，齐革黎是阿撒夫的儿子；

text_en: and Obadiah son of Shemaiah, son of Galal, son of Jeduthun, and Berechiah son of Asa, son of Elkanah, who lived in the villages of the Netophathites.
text_cn: 还有舍玛雅的儿子敖巴狄雅；舍玛雅是加拉耳的儿子，加拉耳是耶杜通的儿子；还有阿撒的儿子贝勒基雅；阿撒是厄耳卡纳的儿子；厄耳卡纳居住在乃托法人的村庄内。

text_en: The gatekeepers were: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman; and their kindred Shallum was the chief,
text_cn: 守门者中，有沙隆、阿谷布、塔耳孟和阿希曼；他们的兄弟沙隆为首，

text_en: stationed previously in the king’s gate on the east side. These were the gatekeepers of the camp of the Levites.
text_cn: 直到现今他们看守东面的王门；他们曾作过肋未营内的守门者。

text_en: Shallum son of Kore, son of Ebiasaph, son of Korah, and his kindred of his ancestral house, the Korahites, were in charge of the work of the service, guardians of the thresholds of the tent, as their ancestors had been in charge of the camp of the Lord , guardians of the entrance.
text_cn: 沙隆是科勒的儿子，科勒是阿彼雅撒夫的儿子，阿彼雅撒夫是科辣黑的儿子；他家族内的兄弟科辣黑人担任敬礼的工作，看守会幕的门槛；他们的祖先曾在上主的军营中防守营门。

text_en: And Phinehas son of Eleazar was chief over them in former times; the Lord was with him.
text_cn: 厄肋阿匝尔的儿子丕乃哈斯曾作过他们的首领。──愿天主与他们同在！

text_en: Zechariah son of Meshelemiah was gatekeeper at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
text_cn: 默舍肋米雅的儿子则加黎雅曾看守会幕的大门。

text_en: All these, who were chosen as gatekeepers at the thresholds, were two hundred twelve. They were enrolled by genealogies in their villages. David and the seer Samuel established them in their office of trust.
text_cn: 被选看守门槛的，共计二百一十二人。他们曾在本村庄内登过记，达味和先见者撒慕尔给他们派定了这职务。

text_en: So they and their descendants were in charge of the gates of the house of the Lord , that is, the house of the tent, as guards.
text_cn: 他们和自己的子孙在天主的圣殿，即会幕门口任守卫之职，

text_en: The gatekeepers were on the four sides, east, west, north, and south;
text_cn: 守卫东西南北四方的大门。

text_en: and their kindred who were in their villages were obliged to come in every seven days, in turn, to be with them;
text_cn: 在村庄住的同族兄弟，每七天应依时来同他们换班，

text_en: for the four chief gatekeepers, who were Levites, were in charge of the chambers and the treasures of the house of God.
text_cn: 因为四位守门之长是肋未人，应常值班看守天主圣殿的厢房和库房。

text_en: And they would spend the night near the house of God; for on them lay the duty of watching, and they had charge of opening it every morning.
text_cn: 所以应在天主圣殿的四周过夜，因为他们有守护和每晨开门的职责。

text_en: Some of them had charge of the utensils of service, for they were required to count them when they were brought in and taken out.
text_cn: 他们中有些人照管行礼的器皿，依数取出，原数送回；

text_en: Others of them were appointed over the furniture, and over all the holy utensils, also over the choice flour, the wine, the oil, the incense, and the spices.
text_cn: 有些人照管用具，即圣所内的一切用具，以及面粉、酒、油、乳香和香料；

text_en: Others, of the sons of the priests, prepared the mixing of the spices,
text_cn: 但用香料配制香液是司祭子孙的职务。

text_en: and Mattithiah, one of the Levites, the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, was in charge of making the flat cakes.
text_cn: 肋未人玛提提雅，科辣黑族人沙隆的长子，负责照管烤饼的事。

text_en: Also some of their kindred of the Kohathites had charge of the rows of bread, to prepare them for each sabbath.
text_cn: 他们的兄弟刻哈特的子孙，每安息日照料备制供饼的事。

text_en: Now these are the singers, the heads of ancestral houses of the Levites, living in the chambers of the temple free from other service, for they were on duty day and night.
text_cn: 这些是歌咏员······肋未家族的族长，住在厢房内，不做别的事，只日夜执行自己的职务。

text_en: These were heads of ancestral houses of the Levites, according to their generations; these leaders lived in Jerusalem.
text_cn: 以上是肋未家族按家系，在耶路撒冷的族长。

text_en: In Gibeon lived the father of Gibeon, Jeiel, and the name of his wife was Maacah.
text_cn: 住在基贝红的，有基贝红的父亲耶依耳，他的妻子名叫玛阿加。

text_en: His firstborn son was Abdon, then Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
text_cn: 他的长子阿贝冬、其次是族尔，克士、巴耳、乃尔、纳达布、

text_en: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, and Mikloth;
text_cn: 革多尔、阿希约、则加黎雅和米刻罗特。

text_en: and Mikloth became the father of Shimeam; and these also lived opposite their kindred in Jerusalem, with their kindred.
text_cn: 米刻罗特生史曼；他们兄弟彼此为邻，住在耶路撒冷。

text_en: Ner became the father of Kish, Kish of Saul, Saul of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Esh-baal;
text_cn: 乃尔生克士，克士生撒乌耳，撒乌耳生约纳堂、玛耳基叔亚、阿彼纳达布和依市巴耳。

text_en: and the son of Jonathan was Merib-baal; and Merib-baal became the father of Micah.
text_cn: 约纳堂的儿子：默黎巴耳；默黎巴耳生米加；

text_en: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, and Ahaz;
text_cn: 米加的儿子：丕东、默肋客、塔勒亚和阿哈兹。

text_en: and Ahaz became the father of Jarah, and Jarah of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri became the father of Moza.
text_cn: 阿哈兹生约阿达，约阿达生阿肋默特、阿次玛委特和齐默黎；齐默黎生摩匝，

text_en: Moza became the father of Binea; and Rephaiah was his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.
text_cn: 摩匝生彼纳；彼纳的儿子勒法雅，勒法雅的儿子厄拉撒，厄拉撒的儿子阿责耳；

text_en: Azel had six sons, and these are their names: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan; these were the sons of Azel.
text_cn: 阿责耳有六个儿子，他们的名字是：阿次黎冈、波革鲁、依市玛耳、沙黎雅、敖巴狄雅和哈南：以上是阿责耳的儿子。
